Hawk Ridge Management Raised Stake in Gentherm (THRM) as Share Value Rose; Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors Increases Holding in Alexander & Baldwin (ALEX)
May 29, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Hawk Ridge Management Llc increased its stake in Gentherm Inc (THRM) by 123.44% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hawk Ridge Management Llc bought 205,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.52% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 371,075 shares of the o.e.m. company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.60 million, up from 166,075 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hawk Ridge Management Llc who had been investing in Gentherm Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.29B market cap company. The stock increased 1.15% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $35.1. About 152,378 shares traded. Gentherm Incorporated (NASDAQ:THRM) has declined 5.39% since May 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.96% the S&P500.
